paragraphs.text: Furgul , also known as the Quag Nurturer , is a Devkarin elf on Ravnica aligned with the Golgari .

Furgul is a character introduced with the release of Alchemy: Karlov Manor on Magic: The Gathering Arena . Clad in earthy-toned, layered armor and wearing the traditional Devkarin face paint, Furgul works within the swampy, leech-infested environment of the Ravnican Undercity . Furgul is a leechbreeder , feeding and nurturing them while they slither through the glowing ooze on the ground and grow into fearsome creatures. He can raise two-headed leeches , some of them reaching impressive sizes.
